title: Statistics of centralizers of integer matrices

definitions.name: x2611_11287_lattice_count
definitions.notes: Cardinality of integer matrices in S with every entry in [−H,H]. Set.ncard is applied to a finite bounded set, including the empty set at negative H.

definitions.name: x2611_11287_centralizer_dim
definitions.notes: Dimension over the specified field F of the full centralizer subalgebra. For an integer matrix, map entries to ℚ before calling this definition.

definitions.name: x2611_11287_centralizer_count
definitions.notes: Number of bounded integer matrices commuting with A. Using the ℤ-centralizer submodule gives precisely the intersection of the rational centralizer with bounded integer matrices.

definitions.name: x2611_11287_exceptional_count
definitions.notes: The paper’s C_n(H): bounded integer matrices whose rational centralizer dimension exceeds n.

statements.original:
Let $A=\begin{pmatrix}a_{1}&a_{2}\\
a_{3}&a_{4}\end{pmatrix}\in{\mathcal{M}}_{2}({\mathbb{Z}})$ . Also, define

 $d:=\gcd(a_{2},a_{3},a_{1}-a_{4}),\quad p:=|a_{1}-a_{4}|,\quad N:=\max\{2|a_{2}|,2|a_{3}|,p\},\quad S:=\left\lfloor\frac{2dH}{N}\right\rfloor.$ 

Then, if $H$ is an integer,

• 

if $A=kI_{2}$ for some $k\in{\mathbb{Z}}$ , then $\#\operatorname{C}(A,{\mathbb{Z}};H)=(2H+1)^{4}$ ;

• 

else,

 $\#\operatorname{C}(A,{\mathbb{Z}};H)=(2H+1)(2S+1)-\frac{p}{d}S(S+1).$

  let S : Set (ℕ × ℕ) := Set.Icc 0 H ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 H
  let f : ℕ × ℕ → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ := fun v => !![(v.1 : ℤ), 0; 0, (v.2 : ℤ)]
  let T : Set (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) := {B | B ∈ (Subalgebra.centralizer ℤ
    ({0} : Set (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ))).toSubmodule ∧ ∀ i j, |B i j| ≤ (H : ℤ)}
  have hfin : T.Finite := by
    have hb : {B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ | ∀ i j, B i j ∈ Set.Icc (-(H : ℤ)) H}.Finite :=
      Set.Finite.pi' (fun _ => Set.Finite.pi' (fun _ => Set.finite_Icc _ _))
    apply hb.subset
    intro B hB
    exact fun i j => abs_le.mp (hB.2 i j)
  have hinj : Set.InjOn f S := by
    intro x hx y hy h
    have h₁ := congrArg (fun M => M 0 0) h
    have h₂ := congrArg (fun M => M 1 1) h
    simp [f] at h₁ h₂
    exact Prod.ext h₁ h₂
  have hmap : ∀ v ∈ S, f v ∈ T := by
    intro v hv
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [Subalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff]
    · have h₁ : (v.1 : ℤ) ≤ H := by exact_mod_cast hv.1.2
      have h₂ : (v.2 : ℤ) ≤ H := by exact_mod_cast hv.2.2
      intro i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [f, abs_of_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg _)] <;> omega
  have hn := Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn f hmap hinj hfin
  have hScard : S.ncard = (H + 1) ^ 2 := by
    change (Set.Icc 0 H ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 H).ncard = _
    rw [Set.ncard_prod]
    simp [pow_two]
  rw [hScard] at hn
  exact hn

lemma x2611_11287_thm1_1_asymptotic_eqv_aux_normalized_centralizer (a D b c q u v w : ℤ) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hbez : u * b + v * c + w * q = 1) (B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) :
    B ∈ (Subalgebra.centralizer ℤ ({!![a, D*b; D*c, a-D*q]} :
      Set (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ))).toSubmodule ↔
      ∃ t x : ℤ, B = !![x, t*b; t*c, x-t*q] := by
  simp only [Subalgebra.mem_toSubmodule, Subalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff, forall_eq]
  constructor
  · intro hh
    have h₁ := congrArg (fun M => M 0 0) hh
    have h₂ := congrArg (fun M => M 0 1) hh
    have h₃ := congrArg (fun M => M 1 0) hh
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h₁ h₂ h₃
    have hbc : b * B 1 0 = c * B 0 1 := by
      apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hD)
      nlinarith only [h₁]
    have hqb : q * B 0 1 = b * (B 0 0 - B 1 1) := by
      apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hD)
      nlinarith only [h₂]
    have hqc : q * B 1 0 = c * (B 0 0 - B 1 1) := by
      apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hD)
      nlinarith only [h₃]
    let t := u * B 0 1 + v * B 1 0 + w * (B 0 0 - B 1 1)
    have hb : t * b = B 0 1 := by
      dsimp [t]
      linear_combination B 0 1 * hbez + v * hbc - w * hqb
    have hc : t * c = B 1 0 := by
      dsimp [t]
      linear_combination B 1 0 * hbez - u * hbc - w * hqc
    have hq : t * q = B 0 0 - B 1 1 := by
      dsimp [t]
      linear_combination (B 0 0 - B 1 1) * hbez + u * hqb + v * hqc
    refine ⟨t, B 0 0, ?_⟩
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [hb, hc] <;> omega
  · rintro ⟨t, x, rfl⟩
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring

  have hc : 2 * |c| ≤ m := (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hq : |q| ≤ m := le_max_right _ _
  simp only [Fin.forall_fin_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
  change (|x| ≤ H ∧ |t*b| ≤ H) ∧ |t*c| ≤ H ∧ |x-t*q| ≤ H ↔ _
  simp only [abs_mul]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hx, htb⟩, htc, hxt⟩
    have htq : |t| * |q| ≤ 2 * H := by
      rw [← abs_mul]
      have hx' := abs_le.mp hx
      have hxt' := abs_le.mp hxt
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> omega
    have htm : |t| * m ≤ 2 * H := by

    refine ⟨(Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hm).2 htm, ?_⟩
    have hx' := abs_le.mp hx
    have hxt' := abs_le.mp hxt
    simp only [max_le_iff, le_min_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨ht, hx, hxt⟩
    have htm : |t| * m ≤ 2 * H := (Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hm).1 ht
    have htb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (abs_nonneg t)
    have htc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc (abs_nonneg t)
    simp only [max_le_iff, le_min_iff] at hx hxt
    refine ⟨⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, hxt.1⟩, ?_⟩, ?_, abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> first | omega | nlinarith only [htm, htb, htc]
